provenance.title: Socket spacing
provenance.covers: How many sockets a stretch of free wall gets, how far from doors, windows and corners, and how high. Written from general knowledge in our own words, not copied from the sources.

sources.name: Approved Document M: Access to and use of buildings (UK government). Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.
Approved Document P: Electrical safety, dwellings (UK government). Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.

rules.note: Typical guideline, check local rules. Metres. One socket for each stretch of free wall up to the spacing, with gaps kept clear of doors, windows and corners.
